about: Stage-minute rounding cases (largest remainder), read by app-core's stage_minutes test and packages/ui's stageTimes test so the two copies cannot drift. ms: each stage's time in milliseconds, in flight order; minutes: what each must show.

cases.name: 38:40 + 50:40 + 71:40 make 161 min; rounded one by one they made 162
three equal stages of 20:20 make 61 min; the earliest takes the extra minute
the largest leftover takes the extra minute, wherever it is
exactly half a minute left over rounds up, as the flight's total does
